title: Recyclable CaSiO(3)-Catalyzed Synthesis and Characterization of Indeno[1, 2-d] Pyrimidine Derivatives: In Silico and Preliminary Biological Screening.
authors: Kalasapur, Vinay V; T, Aravinda; B, Vinay Kumar; Naik, Praveen; Fazl-Ur-Rahman, Kashifa; Kugaji, Manohar; Madhusudhana, N; Yogendra, K
one_liner_zh: 该文主要是有机合成吲哚并嘧啶衍生物并进行初步生物筛选，仅附带DFT计算和与A/B-DNA的初步分子对接，蛋白质-DNA互作非核心，方法深度不足，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: An efficient synthetic route was developed for indeno[1,2-d]pyrimidinone and indeno[1,2-d]pyrimidinethione derivatives via a modified Biginelli condensation of aryl aldehydes, 5-chloroindanone, and urea/thiourea. The reaction, catalyzed by recyclable calcium silicate, proceeded under mild conditions to afford the target compounds in good to high yields, with the catalyst maintaining activity over multiple cycles. The catalyst was characterized using powder x-ray diffraction, scanning electron microscopy, and transmission electron microscopy to confirm its structural integrity. The molecular structures of the synthesized derivatives were supported by proton nuclear magnetic resonance, infrared spectroscopy, and mass spectrometry. Green chemistry metrics, including atom economy, reaction mass efficiency, and E-factor, were used to evaluate the sustainability of the developed synthetic protocol. Density functional theory calculations provided insights into the electronic properties of the compounds. Preliminary and complementary biological studies, including cytotoxicity screening, DNA binding, and cleavage, were carried out to explore potential biological behavior. Preliminary molecular docking with A/B -DNA was also performed to provide a tentative understanding of possible interactions. A predictive structure-activity trend analysis was carried out to correlate structural features with observed trends in cytotoxicity. These biological evaluations are exploratory in nature, intended for the identification of promising leads for further study.
abstract_zh: 开发了一条高效合成路线，用于通过改进的Biginelli缩合反应制备茚并[1,2-d]嘧啶酮和茚并[1,2-d]嘧啶硫酮衍生物，该反应涉及芳基醛、5-氯茚酮和尿素/硫脲。该反应由可回收的硅酸钙催化，在温和条件下进行，以良好至高的产率获得目标化合物，且催化剂在多次循环中保持活性。通过粉末X射线衍射、扫描电子显微镜和透射电子显微镜对催化剂进行了表征，以确认其结构完整性。合成衍生物的分子结构通过质子核磁共振、红外光谱和质谱得到支持。绿色化学指标，包括原子经济性、反应质量效率和E因子，用于评估所开发合成方案的可持性。密度泛函理论计算提供了对化合物电子性质的见解。初步和补充性生物学研究，包括细胞毒性筛选、DNA结合和切割，旨在探索潜在的生物学行为。还进行了与A/B-DNA的初步分子对接，以提供对可能相互作用的初步理解。进行了预测性结构-活性趋势分析，以关联结构特征与观察到的细胞毒性趋势。这些生物学评估属于探索性质，旨在识别有前景的先导化合物以供进一步研究。
